danger_formalization.robot_task: Move two tissue boxes from a counter to the back of a toilet.
danger_formalization.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges distance or placement while putting a tissue box on the back of the toilet, causing it to fall into the toilet bowl.
danger_formalization.result_of_danger: Contamination of the tissue box and potential water damage.
danger_formalization.danger_action: Putting the tissue box down on the back of the toilet.
danger_formalization.instantaneous_solution: Robot uses sensors to verify precise placement on a stable surface before releasing the tissue box.
danger_formalization.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation and navigation capabilities in a typical indoor bathroom environment.
